title: God Calls Abram
summary: In God Calls Abram, kids slow down long enough to see the choice, pressure, or promise inside the passage. Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step. God called Abram to leave home and follow His promise.

read_it.prompt: Read Genesis 12:1-9 and underline the part that best shows faith.

tell_it: God called Abram to leave home and follow His promise. God told Abram to leave his country and promised to bless him. Abram trusted God and went.
understand_it: Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step. God Calls Abram gives children a way to connect the Bible event to choices they actually face.
age_5_7_explanation: God called Abram to leave home and follow His promise.
age_8_11_explanation: God told Abram to leave his country and promised to bless him. Abram trusted God and went. Kids can notice faith in the choices people make, not only in the famous part of the story. Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step.
teen_explanation: Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step. When a new place or change feels scary, Abram's story shows that obedience can begin before you know every detail. Teens can also notice the tension in the passage: faith is not always easy, immediate, or admired by everyone nearby.
key_truths: Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step.
God Calls Abram shows faith through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When a new place or change feels scary, Abram's story shows that obedience can begin before you know every detail.
life_application: When a new place or change feels scary, Abram's story shows that obedience can begin before you know every detail.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer belongs to God Calls Abram?
choices: He went as God told him
quiz_questions.answer: He went as God told him
quiz_questions.explanation: He went as God told him is the correct answer. The detail matters because it keeps the lesson tied to Genesis 12:1-9, not just a general idea.

quiz_questions.question: God Calls Abram is mainly about faith without ignoring the actual Bible story.
quiz_questions.explanation: The theme matters because it grows out of Genesis 12:1-9, not from a random moral pasted onto the end.

memory_verse.prompt: Genesis 12:4 gives this lesson a short Scripture anchor to remember.

discussion_questions: What happened first in God Calls Abram, and what changed by the end?
Where do you see faith in God Calls Abram?
What is one small choice God Calls Abram could shape this week?

activity.title: Map of Trust
activity.instructions: Draw a simple map from familiar to unknown, then mark where Abram had to trust God.

prayer_prompt: Father, help me see what God Calls Abram teaches and practice faith in a real choice this week.
